text:
Gabe (Finance): Flagging a pricing variance on the June AWS Marketplace batch for ChannelMate. They say the unit price on the marketplace listing dropped to promo-test price for two days and affected invoice totals.
Yara (Partner Sales): Oof. We ran a short A/B price experiment but it should have been isolated to internal test accounts only. Which invoice is impacted?
Gabe (Finance): INV-2026-06-09 shows marketplace SKU priced at $0.045/token instead of contracted $0.075/token for partner PART-214. Quick CSV excerpt below.
Ibrahim (Billing): Pulling raw lines now:
```
invoice_id,sku,partner_id,units,unit_price,charge
INV-2026-06-09,redwood.market.generation,PART-214,200000,0.045,9000
INV-2026-06-09,redwood.channel.seats,PART-214,50,20,1000
```
Ibrahim (Billing): Expected charge should have been 200k * 0.075 = 15k, so undercharged by 6k.
Clara (Revenue Ops): That's a material miss. Need to determine whether to invoice an arrears charge or absorb as a one-time adjustment. Also check sales agreement: ChannelMate's contract allows us to adjust billing errors within 60 days.
BillingBot: Audit log: PRICE_EXPERIMENT_APPLY applied variant "promo-test-2026-06" to listing redwood.market.generation between 2026-06-07T03:00Z and 2026-06-09T05:12Z. Targeting filter was "env:internal-test" but rule evaluated true for partner PART-214 due to missing env tag.
Yara (Partner Sales): We need to be careful here. Customer-facing ask: do we invoice a catch-up, or offer credit? Partner sensitivity about surprise charges.
Gabe (Finance): For accounting we must decide: 1) issue corrective invoice for difference (6k) and collect, or 2) issue a goodwill credit to customer and take hit to revenue. Which preserves relationships?
Clara (Revenue Ops): From a revenue recognition perspective, if we issue an arrears invoice we'll recognize the 6k as additional revenue in June/close. If we credit, we will reduce recognized revenue. Need approval from Revenue Ops and Sales on collection.
Ibrahim (Billing): Operationally we can: a) create an adjustment invoice ADJ-2026-06-09-1 +6,000, b) or create credit CR-2026-06-09-1 -6,000 and mark as internal reimbursement. Both easy to do but need policy decision.
Yara (Partner Sales): I'll reach out to ChannelMate and propose two options: corrected invoice for the underbilled amount or a 50% goodwill credit. Will report back.
Gabe (Finance): Also please capture GL mapping: if we invoice arrears, post to accounts_receivable and recognize revenue; if credit, post to contra_revenue. We need the JE ready for month close.
BillingBot: Note: price experiment rollback executed 2026-06-09T05:12Z. Affected partners detected: PART-214, PART-220.
Clara (Revenue Ops): Check if PART-220 was similarly impacted. If we've underbilled multiple partners the impact could be larger; produce an impact summary.
Ibrahim (Billing): Summary: PART-214 undercharged 6,000; PART-220 undercharged 2,400. Combined 8,400.
Gabe (Finance): Ok combined impact 8.4k. Still material for monthly P&L. Recommend we default to corrected invoices and allow Sales to negotiate credits for sensitive partners.
Yara (Partner Sales): ChannelMate response: "We appreciate transparency; please invoice the catch-up. We'll pay under normal terms." They also asked for assurance this won't recur.
Clara (Revenue Ops): With partner OK, proceed to issue ADJ-2026-06-09-1 invoice for 6,000 and ADJ-2026-06-09-2 for PART-220 amount 2,400. Billing, please include line-item proof and experiment log.
Ibrahim (Billing): Will create invoices ADJ-2026-06-09-1 (6,000) & ADJ-2026-06-09-2 (2,400). Also adding narrative: "Correction for temporary pricing experiment applied in error 2026-06-07 to 2026-06-09."
Gabe (Finance): Make sure collection terms are 30 days and flag accounts receivable. Clara, coordinate JE entries.
Clara (Revenue Ops): JE-2026-06-120 created to record additional revenue and AR. Posting pending review.
BillingBot: Regression action: block-price-experiments-on-live-listings PR opened by infra to add an explicit partner-tag whitelist.
Yara (Partner Sales): I'll follow up with ChannelMate to close the loop and share the infra PR number.
Gabe (Finance): Great. Also document this in the promo/experiment runbook: require partner-tag validation and a dry-run audit before rollout.
Ibrahim (Billing): Invoices created and queued: ADJ-2026-06-09-1 (PART-214, 6000), ADJ-2026-06-09-2 (PART-220, 2400). Partner notifications sent.
Clara (Revenue Ops): JE posted and accounted. Closing internal audit.
Gabe (Finance): Thanks all. Please confirm once AR receipts come in.
Yara (Partner Sales): ChannelMate confirmed payment scheduled. Closing. :white_check_mark:
